**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no redline proposed).**

Section 11.1 auto-renews for one-year periods only, with a mutual 30-day non-renewal notice window — inside the 60-day fallback ceiling and equal to the preferred 30-day opt-out. No renewal price-uplift mechanic exists anywhere (Section 4 fees run to Exhibit B, which fixes "Year 2-5, and beyond" pricing; Exhibit B Payment Terms adds no escalator), so both price-cap elements are inapplicable. The only gap versus the preferred position is the missing 60-day Vendor renewal reminder, noted in the rationale rather than flagged.
